# 1781. Sum of Beauty of All Substrings

## Solution 1 (time O(n^2), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def beautySum(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(s)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n):
            d = collections.defaultdict(int)
            for j in range(i, n):
                d[s[j]] += 1
                ans += max(d.values()) - min(d.values())
        return ans
```
